definitions.explanation: An organic acid produced by fermentation and by muscles during intense exercise. Familiar from fermented foods and from the discussion of muscle fatigue.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}で{乳酸|にゅうさん}がたまる。
examples.english: Lactic acid builds up from exercise.

examples.japanese: ヨーグルトは{乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}で{作|つく}られる。
examples.english: Yogurt is made with lactic acid bacteria.

examples.japanese: {激|はげ}しい{運動|うんどう}のあと、{筋肉|きんにく}に{乳酸|にゅうさん}がたまって{重|おも}く{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: After hard exercise, lactic acid accumulates in the muscles and they feel heavy.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳酸|にゅうさん}がたまる: lactic acid builds up
- {乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん}: lactic acid bacteria
- {乳酸|にゅうさん}{発酵|はっこう}: lactic fermentation

NOTE: {乳酸菌|にゅうさんきん} (lactic acid bacteria) is the everyday term seen on yogurt and other fermented-food labels.
